sourceLabel: 26 石雷鹏大作文笔记 - 英语二（整理自：学长小谭）
scope: 图表作文（图表类大作文）

pages.title: 第三章 图表作文 · 审题三事项与数据本质透析
pageNotes: 审题：题目读三遍，否则不动笔
a.英文指令(Directions)：关注英文质量要求，这是首要审题事项
b.关注图表中的数字：必须准确提取图表中的关键数据信息
c.文字说明：注意图表周边的文字标注和补充说明
数据较多时，如何选择重点? 起点、终点、拐点、最高值、最低值…
重点数据标准：最高值（图表中的顶点数据必须描述）、最低值（图表中的底部数据必须描述）、拐点（趋势发生明显变化的转折点数据）、特殊值（如零值或其他具有特殊意义的数据）
图形归类与本质：折线图（curve 曲线/line 线 graph）、柱状图（bar chart 柱子 or column 栏目 chart）→ 变化：趋势；饼图（pie chart）、表格(table/form) → 排序：对比；组合图 → 对比＋趋势
透析：固定时间段内，相同事物写变化；固定时间点/段，不同事物写对比或排序

pages.title: 3.3 变化类词汇与句式（趋势描述五大句型）

entries.origin: 3.3 变化类词汇与句式 · 例句（上升）
entries.section: 图表作文 动态·上升趋势例句
entries.originalText: From 1977 to 1980, there was an upward trend in the number of birds, from 120 million to the highest point/peak at approximately/about/some 127 million.
entries.en: From {起始年份} to {结束年份}, there was an upward trend in the number of {数据主体}, from {起始数值} to the highest point at approximately {峰值}.
entries.zh: 从{起始年份}到{结束年份}，{数据主体}的数量呈上升趋势，从{起始数值}升至约{峰值}的最高点。
notes: 上升名词：an increase to/by..., a rise, a growth, a jump, a surge, a boom, an upward trend

entries.origin: 3.3 变化类词汇与句式 · 例句（平稳）
entries.section: 图表作文 动态·平稳趋势例句
entries.originalText: Before 2007, there had been a steady rise in the subscription number of mobile phones in developed nations, and it remained stable at 1 billion in 2008.
entries.en: Before {年份}, there had been a steady rise in {数据主体}, and it remained stable at {数值} in {结束年份}.
entries.zh: 在{年份}之前，{数据主体}稳步上升，并在{结束年份}稳定在{数值}。
notes: 平稳不变动词：level out/off；did not change at
持续上升/下降：keep going up；maintained a downward trend；demonstrate the trend of saturation

entries.origin: 【句型句法】1）主谓
entries.section: 图表作文 句型一·主谓（数据主体做主语）
entries.originalText: Between 1940 and 1985, the proportion （比例）of the elderly （老年的）people increased remarkably （明显地）from approximately 7% in Sweden and 9% in the USA to 13% and 15% respectively （分别地）.
entries.en: Between {起始年份} and {结束年份}, the proportion of {数据主体} increased remarkably from approximately {起始数值A} in {对象A} and {起始数值B} in {对象B} to {结束数值A} and {结束数值B} respectively.
entries.zh: 在{起始年份}到{结束年份}之间，{数据主体}的比例明显上升，从{对象A}的约{起始数值A}和{对象B}的{起始数值B}分别升至{结束数值A}和{结束数值B}。
notes: 句型一：数据主体做主语 + v（increase/decrease）
respectively 表示分别地，用于多对象并列
变化程度原则：形容词修饰名词，副词修饰动词、形容词、副词、句子

entries.origin: 【句型句法】2）主谓宾
entries.section: 图表作文 句型二·主谓宾（呈现出变化）
entries.originalText: During the two decades from 1990 to 2010, the proportion of the old showed a considerable surge of 12%, reaching (arriving at) 35%.
entries.en: During the period from {起始年份} to {结束年份}, the proportion of {数据主体} showed a considerable surge of {变化幅度}, reaching {结束数值}.
entries.zh: 在{起始年份}到{结束年份}这段时间里，{数据主体}的比例大幅激增{变化幅度}，达到{结束数值}。
notes: 句型二：主体 + 呈现/表现出（show/demonstrate/display）+ 变化（名词）
语法点：v-ing 表伴随，主谓一致，且两个动作几乎同时发生

entries.origin: 【句型句法】3）主谓宾（拟人）
entries.section: 图表作文 句型三·拟人（年代/地点做主语）
entries.originalText: The period from 1940 to 1985 witnessed a steady and slight growth in the proportion of...
entries.en: The period from {起始年份} to {结束年份} witnessed a steady and slight growth in the proportion of {数据主体}.
entries.zh: 从{起始年份}到{结束年份}这段时期，{数据主体}的比例稳步小幅增长。
notes: 句型三：年代/地点 + saw/witnessed + 变化（名词），是拟人化表达，比主谓句更显文采

entries.origin: 【句型句法】4）there be 句式
entries.section: 图表作文 句型四·there be 句式
entries.originalText: From （从…开始）this year onward, there was a gradual growth in the number of students who attended online courses, reaching the peak at 2.3 billion.
entries.en: From {起始年份} onward, there was a gradual growth in the number of {数据主体}, reaching the peak at {峰值}.
entries.zh: 从{起始年份}起，{数据主体}的数量逐步增长，达到{峰值}的峰值。
notes: 句型四：There was + increase in...
From...onward 表示从某时间起

entries.origin: 【句型句法】5）主谓（变化发生在）
entries.section: 图表作文 句型五·变化发生在某时段
entries.originalText: A considerable increase in the number of students who attended online courses occurred during the past decade, from 1.23 million to 4.89 million.
entries.en: A considerable increase in the number of {数据主体} occurred during {时间段}, from {起始数值} to {结束数值}.
entries.zh: {数据主体}的数量在{时间段}期间大幅增长，从{起始数值}增至{结束数值}。
notes: 句型五：变化（名词做主语）+ 发生在（occurred）+ 时间段

pageNotes: 【数量单位】dozen / hundred / thousand / million 百万 / billion 十亿 / trillion 万亿
小问题：「几百」怎么说？Two hundred; hundreds of
【时间点/段】in 1990 / from 1990 to 1992 / since 1990 (has been) / after 1992 / between 1990 and 1998 / during the period from...to... / ten years = a decade
【变化程度】原则：形容词修饰名词；副词修饰动词、形容词、副词、句子

vocab.en: increase, rise (rose), climb, jump, go up, grow, ascend
surge, shoot (shot) up, boom, soar, leap
an increase to/by, a rise, a growth, a jump, a surge, a boom, an upward trend
decrease, decline, descend, go down, fall, be reduced, drop, sink (sank), dip, shrink, diminish
a decrease, a decline, a fall, a drop, a slump in, a reduction in, a downward trend in
sharp/sharply, rapidly, dramatically, drastic/drastically, considerably, remarkably, extremely, strikingly, substantially, enormously, exponentially, significantly, greatly, steeply
gradually, moderately, steadily, slightly, marginally, fractionally, step by step/little by little
level out/off; did not change at
remain stable/steady/constant at; stay constant at; maintained the same level at
the highest point; the peak; the top

pages.title: 3.4 对比/排序类词汇与句式

entries.origin: 3.4 对比/排序类 · 【分类】
entries.section: 图表作文 静态·分类句
entries.originalText: The meat sold in the supermarket can be classified into six types/ kinds/ sorts/ categories.
entries.en: {数据主体} can be classified into {数量} types.
entries.zh: {数据主体}可以分为{数量}类。
notes: 静态图表（饼图/表格）先分类，再排序

entries.origin: 3.4 对比/排序类 · 【排序】最大项
entries.section: 图表作文 静态·排序句（最大项）
entries.originalText: ....has/is the largest proportion，which accounts for * %. / which makes up/constitutes * %. / at/with * %. / constituting * %.
entries.en: {对象A} has the largest proportion, which accounts for {数值A}.
entries.zh: {对象A}占比最大，为{数值A}。
notes: 讲义给出四种同义变体：which accounts for、which makes up/constitutes、at/with、constituting

entries.origin: 3.4 对比/排序类 · 【排序】次序与末位
entries.section: 图表作文 静态·排序句（次序与末位）
entries.originalText: Then, the next is/are C with * %, followed by D at*%. Finally come E, F and G at * %, *% and * % respectively.
entries.en: Then, the next is {对象B} with {数值B}, followed by {对象C} at {数值C}. Finally come {对象D} at {数值D}.
entries.zh: 接下来是{对象B}，占{数值B}，其后是{对象C}，占{数值C}。最后是{对象D}，占{数值D}。
notes: Finally come 是倒装结构，主语在后时用复数动词
respectively 用于多个数值一一对应

entries.origin: 3.4 对比/排序类 · 【排序】倍数对比
entries.section: 图表作文 静态·倍数对比句
entries.originalText: It is also noticeable that the sale of...is three times as much as that of…
entries.en: It is also noticeable that {对象A} is {倍数} times as much as {对象B}.
entries.zh: 同样明显的是，{对象A}是{对象B}的{倍数}倍。
notes: 倍数表达：... times as much as that of ...，that of 指代前文名词避免重复

pages.title: 精讲1：全球手机市场（10 年）· 首段与主体段骨架

entries.origin: 精讲1：全球手机市场（10 年）· 首句
entries.section: 图表作文第一段·首句（图表形式＋数据主体＋地点＋时间）
entries.originalText: Given is a column chart, clearly illustrating the remarkable contrasts in mobile-phone subscriptions between developing and developed nations from 2000 to 2008.
entries.en: Given is a {图表类型}, clearly illustrating the remarkable contrasts in {数据主体} between {对象A} and {对象B} from {起始年份} to {结束年份}.
entries.zh: 所给是一幅{图表类型}，清晰展示了{起始年份}到{结束年份}{对象A}和{对象B}在{数据主体}方面的显著差异。

examples.label: 10 年英语二真题（全球手机市场）
examples.en: Given is a column chart, clearly illustrating the remarkable contrasts in mobile-phone subscriptions between developing and developed nations from 2000 to 2008.
examples.zh: 所给是一幅柱状图，清晰展示了2000 年到2008 年发展中国家和发达国家手机订购量之间的显著差异。

notes: 第一句：图表形式＋数据主体＋地点＋时间
Given is 也可写成 This is/It is/There is a…
第一句或者写成 This chart is for the purpose of illustrating…
between 用于两者之间，三者及以上对比用 among

entries.origin: 精讲1：全球手机市场（10 年）· 首段数据描述
entries.section: 图表作文第一段·数据描述（小幅上涨后平稳）
entries.originalText: During the period, the subscription in developed countries showed a slight growth, from 600 million to 900 million. Then, it remained stable at 1 billion in 2007 and 2008.
entries.en: During the period, {数据主体} in {对象A} showed a slight growth, from {起始数值} to {中间数值}. Then, it remained stable at {结束数值} in {结束年份}.
entries.zh: 在此期间，{对象A}的{数据主体}表现出小幅上涨，从{起始数值}到{中间数值}。此后，数据在{结束年份}稳定在{结束数值}。
notes: 2000 年-2008 年的数据不需要全部都写
只写起点、终点、拐点、最高值、最低值

entries.origin: 精讲1：全球手机市场（10 年）· 首段对比描述
entries.section: 图表作文第一段·对比描述（猛涨达峰）
entries.originalText: By contrast, the number of mobile phone subscriptions in developing countries was merely 500 million in 2000, but it surged sharply, reaching the peak at 4 billion in 2008.
entries.en: By contrast, the number of {数据主体} in {对象B} was merely {起始数值} in {起始年份}, but it surged sharply, reaching the peak at {峰值} in {结束年份}.
entries.zh: 相比之下，{对象B}的{数据主体}在{起始年份}仅为{起始数值}，然后该数据迅速飙升，并在{结束年份}达到了{峰值}的最高值。
notes: By contrast 是图表作文最核心的对比连接词

entries.origin: 精讲1：全球手机市场（10 年）· 第二段过渡句
entries.section: 图表作文第二段·过渡设问句
entries.originalText: Such statistics, apparently, can be associated with the rapid advance of the global mobile phone industry, but what resulted in the differences above? (选写：To my understanding, at least two fundamental causes/reasons can account for this phenomenon.)
entries.en: Such statistics, apparently, can be associated with {现象概括}, but what resulted in the differences above? To my understanding, at least two fundamental causes can account for this phenomenon.
entries.zh: 上述数据，显然，能被联系到{现象概括}。但是什么导致以上差异呢？在我看来，至少两个根本原因可以解释这种现象。
notes: 括号内为选写内容，可根据字数决定是否写
这一句同时完成「承接首段数据」与「引出原因分析」两个功能

entries.origin: 精讲1：全球手机市场（10 年）· 第二段原因一
entries.section: 图表作文第二段·原因一（For one thing）
entries.originalText: For one thing, in recent years, developing countries were characterized by their economic boom, which enabled residents there to possess additional money to purchase and utilize mobile phones. A case in point is China.
entries.en: For one thing, in recent years, {对象B} were characterized by {原因一特征}, which enabled {受影响群体} to {产生的行为}. A case in point is {举例}.
entries.zh: 一方面，近年来，{对象B}的突出特征就在于{原因一特征}，这使得{受影响群体}{产生的行为}。一个典型例子就是{举例}。
notes: be characterized by 是石雷鹏体系的核心句式，意为「突出特征在于」
A case in point is 用于举实例，比 for example 更高级

entries.origin: 精讲1：全球手机市场（10 年）· 第二段原因二
entries.section: 图表作文第二段·原因二（For another）
entries.originalText: For another, compared with developing countries, developed nations enjoyed a smaller market due to their smaller population. So, it displayed the trend of saturation.
entries.en: For another, compared with {对象B}, {对象A} enjoyed {对比劣势} due to {原因二}. So, it displayed the trend of {结果趋势}.
entries.zh: 另一方面，与{对象B}相比，由于{原因二}，{对象A}享有的{对比劣势}。所以，它表现出了{结果趋势}的趋势。
notes: For one thing... For another... 是固定搭配，用于两点并列
compared with 引出对比，due to 后接名词

pages.title: 精讲1：全球手机市场（10 年）· 尾段骨架与替换词

entries.origin: 精讲1：全球手机市场（10 年）· 尾段建议一
entries.section: 图表作文第三段·建议一（应关注某方面）
entries.originalText: Accordingly, mobile phone manufacturers are supposed to pay more attention to the market in developing nations because of its huge potential.
entries.en: Accordingly, {行动主体} are supposed to pay more attention to {关注对象} because of its huge potential.
entries.zh: 因此，{行动主体}应更多关注{关注对象}，因为其潜力巨大。
notes: 尾段第一句给出针对性建议，行动主体要与题目图表对应

entries.origin: 精讲1：全球手机市场（10 年）· 尾段建议二
entries.section: 图表作文第三段·建议二（应制定策略）
entries.originalText: In addition, it is advisable for them to work out comprehensive strategies to consolidate the market in developed countries.
entries.en: In addition, it is advisable for them to work out comprehensive strategies to {改进目标}.
entries.zh: 此外，他们应制定综合性策略来{改进目标}。
notes: it is advisable for sb. to do sth. 是建议句核心句式

entries.origin: 精讲1：全球手机市场（10 年）· 尾段展望
entries.section: 图表作文第三段·展望句（条件句收尾）
entries.originalText: If they do their utmost, the future of mobile-phone industry will be promising.
entries.en: If they do their utmost, the future of {展望对象} will be promising.
entries.zh: 如果他们能尽全力这样来做，{展望对象}的明天将一片光明。
notes: 条件句展望收尾，语法上是 if 引导的真实条件句
全文 229 words

vocab.en: manufacturers = makers = producers = companies = firms = corporations
are supposed to = are well-advised to

pages.title: 实训1：中国汽车市场（11 年）· 首段与主体段（三对象对比）

entries.origin: 实训1：中国汽车市场（11 年）· 首句（三对象）
entries.section: 图表作文第一段·首句（三个及以上对象用 among）
entries.originalText: Given/This/It/There/Provided/Presented is a column chart, clearly illustrating/showing/displaying/presenting the remarkable contrasts in China's market shares/percentages/proportions among Chinese, Japanese and car brands from 2008 to 2009.
entries.en: Given is a {图表类型}, clearly illustrating the remarkable contrasts in {数据主体} among {对象A}, {对象B} and {对象C} from {起始年份} to {结束年份}.
entries.zh: 所给的是一个{图表类型}，清晰展示了{起始年份}到{结束年份}{对象A}、{对象B}和{对象C}在{数据主体}方面的显著对比。

examples.label: 11 年英语二真题（中国汽车市场）
examples.en: This is a column chart that clearly illustrates the dramatic changes in China's market shares among Chinese, American and Japanese car brands from 2008 to 2009.
examples.zh: 所给是一个柱状图，清晰展示了2008 和2009 年的中、美、日系汽车品牌在中国汽车市场的份额明显差异。

notes: 三个及以上对象对比必须用 among，不能用 between

entries.origin: 实训1：中国汽车市场（11 年）· 首段上升描述
entries.section: 图表作文第一段·明显增长描述
entries.originalText: During this/the year, the proportion/share of Chinese brands showed an evident/sharp/striking growth, from 25% to approximately/about/nearly/almost/roughly 33%.
entries.en: During this year, the proportion of {对象A} showed an evident growth, from {起始数值} to approximately {结束数值}.
entries.zh: 在此期间，{对象A}的份额表现出明显增长，从{起始数值}增至大约{结束数值}。
notes: 约数表达有五种：approximately/about/nearly/almost/roughly

entries.origin: 实训1：中国汽车市场（11 年）· 首段下降与平稳并列
entries.section: 图表作文第一段·下降与平稳并列描述
entries.originalText: By contrast, the share of Japanese cars decreased/descended/declined/fell sharply, from the peak of. Meanwhile, the percentage of American brands maintained/remained stable at 15%.
entries.en: By contrast, the share of {对象B} declined sharply, from {起始数值} to {结束数值}. Meanwhile, the percentage of {对象C} remained stable at {平稳数值}.
entries.zh: 相反之下，{对象B}的占比表现出明显下降，从{起始数值}跌至{结束数值}。同时，{对象C}的份额保持稳定在{平稳数值}。
notes: Meanwhile 用于并列第三个对象，避免三句都用 By contrast

entries.origin: 实训1：中国汽车市场（11 年）· 第二段过渡句
entries.section: 图表作文第二段·过渡设问句（竞争类）
entries.originalText: Such statistics, apparently, can be associated with the fierce/intense/tough/stiff/severe competition in China's car/automobile market, but what resulted in the differences above?
entries.en: Such statistics, apparently, can be associated with the fierce competition in {领域}, but what resulted in the differences above?
entries.zh: 这些数据，显然，能被联系到{领域}的激烈竞争，但是什么导致了上述差异？
notes: 竞争类题目专用过渡句，fierce competition 有五种同义表达

entries.origin: 实训1：中国汽车市场（11 年）· 第二段原因一
entries.section: 图表作文第二段·原因一（价格质量优势类）
entries.originalText: For one thing, in recent years, Chinese automobiles have been characterized by the lower prices and improved quality, which enabled or attracted an increasing number of Chinese customers/consumers/buyers/people to choose their own national brands. My family was a case in point.
entries.en: For one thing, in recent years, {对象A} have been characterized by {优势特征}, which attracted an increasing number of {受影响群体} to {产生的行为}. {举例} was a case in point.
entries.zh: 一方面，近些年来，{对象A}的突出特征一直都是{优势特征}，这使得或吸引了越来越多的{受影响群体}{产生的行为}。一个典型例子就是{举例}。
notes: enabled 与 attracted 均可用，前者强调使能，后者强调吸引

entries.origin: 实训1：中国汽车市场（11 年）· 第二段原因二
entries.section: 图表作文第二段·原因二（外部关系恶化类）
entries.originalText: For another, compared with the past years, the relationship between China and Japan (Sino-Japan relation) became worse (more terrible). So, a larger proportion of Chinese people (citizens/residents) did not buy various Japanese products (goods/items/commodities), including cars.
entries.en: For another, compared with the past years, {外部因素} became worse. So, a larger proportion of {受影响群体} did not buy various {相关产品}.
entries.zh: 另一方面，与过去相比，{外部因素}变得更加糟糕。因此，很多{受影响群体}不再购买各种{相关产品}。
notes: compared with the past years 用于时间维度对比

entries.origin: 实训1：中国汽车市场（11 年）· 第二段结果句
entries.section: 图表作文第二段·结果小结句
entries.originalText: So, the sales of Japanese car brands went down (declined/decreased) in China.
entries.en: So, {数据主体} went down in {范围}.
entries.zh: 因此，{数据主体}在{范围}就下降了。
notes: 原因分析后用 So 收束，回扣图表数据

examples.en: Overall, seniors have the largest proportion of part-time jobs, with 88.24%. Then, the next are juniors and sophomores, at 71.93% and 71.13% respectively. Finally come freshmen, with 67.77%.
